newFinding.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the invalid transition across disable**

When the layout is disabled while valid, `ReleaseGate()` sets `valid` to false without notifying the host. Because disabling also releases the `CanvasGroup`, a board pointer can begin while the component is disabled; if it is then re-enabled under an invalid safe area, `Gate(false)` sees `valid` already false and suppresses `ValidityChanged`, so `FightMatchHostView.OnLayoutValidityChanged` never cancels that pointer. Preserve enough state so the first invalid sample after re-enable emits the false transition, without treating disable itself as an input-invalidating event.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L299-L301](https://github.com/yyczz1/FightMatch/blob/ad49aa36ec79505b51dbe5c83ef138f167cdb545/AGENTS.md#L299-L301)
